channel.title: Copilot on Sujith Quintelier
channel.description: Recent content in Copilot on Sujith Quintelier

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Microsoft Copilot harness support in Foundry Toolkit for VS Code
item.description:
Agent Builder in Microsoft Foundry Toolkit for VS Code now supports prompt agents using the Microsoft Copilot harness in public preview. Developers can configure tools and skills, edit local YAML definitions, deploy changes to Foundry, and run the agents.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: vscode: The Copilot harness: Building on a shared foundation
item.description:
VS Code says it is moving from the Local harness to the Copilot harness. The change is based on usage data and user feedback, but the provided text does not include implementation details or timelines.

  • Source: VS Code Updates and Blog

item.title: azure: [In preview] Limited Preview: Azure Workload Center for SAP and Azure Copilot Run SAP Agent
item.description:
Azure Workload Center for SAP is now available in limited preview, paired with Azure Copilot Run SAP Agent. The feature provides a workload-aware experience for operating SAP on Azure, powered by Workload Virtual Instance (WVI).

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Limited Preview: Azure Workload Center for Oracle and Azure Copilot Run Oracle Agent
item.description:
Azure Workload Center for Oracle and the Azure Copilot Run Oracle Agent are in preview as a workload-aware experience for operating Oracle workloads on Azure. The feature is powered by Workload Virtual Instance (WVI).

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Database Agent for SQL with contextual Copilot
item.description:
Database Agent for SQL is now in public preview with contextual Copilot-generated recommendations for detected database issues. The recommendations are grounded in available issue evidence and explain why the issue matters, the likely cause, and the next step.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Track Copilot code review outcomes in Repository insights
item.description:
GitHub added a new Repository insights page for repositories, now the first item in the Insights tab, to show how Copilot code review feedback is received in each repo. It lets you track code review outcomes for Copilot review activity.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot models deprecated on November 16, 2026
item.description:
GitHub deprecated a set of Copilot models on November 16, 2026 across most Copilot experiences, including Chat, inline edits, ask and agent modes, and code completions. The post does not list the specific models in the provided excerpt.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub App support for Enterprise Copilot seat management
item.description:
Enterprise GitHub Apps can now use the enterprise-level Copilot seat management APIs. This lets apps manage which users and enterprise teams are assigned Copilot seats.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: visualstudio: Copilot in Visual Studio Just Got a Major Upgrade
item.description:
Copilot Chat in Visual Studio now uses the Microsoft Copilot SDK starting with Visual Studio 2026 version 18.12. It is enabled by default and is described as a major upgrade with broader task coverage using the same models.

  • Source: Visual Studio Blog

item.title: github: Usage metrics API adds code review details and addressed rate
item.description:
GitHub’s enterprise and organization repository-level Copilot usage metrics now include code review outcome data. The repos-1-day report gains a new copilot_code_review object with counts for feedback handling, including an addressed rate.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: ai: Introducing the Microsoft Copilot harness in Foundry Agent Service
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry is introducing the Microsoft Copilot harness in Foundry Agent Service as part of a shared execution foundation for agent experiences. It is meant to combine context, tools, execution environment, controls, and an agent loop, while preserving customer choice in supported options.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot app, Universe releases
item.description:
GitHub says work often spans multiple repositories and sessions, and can also involve non-repository artifacts like specs, designs, and assets. The post announces GitHub Copilot app and Universe releases, but the provided excerpt does not include specific feature details.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Build shared workflows for your team with Copilot Automations
item.description:
GitHub is rolling out shared Copilot Automations, allowing teams to collaboratively build and maintain AI-powered workflows. The feature lets users combine prompts, triggers, and tools into team workflows.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: visualstudio: Visual Studio October Update – Compare Commits to Your Code, Resolve Conflicts in Bulk, Keep Coding
item.description:
Visual Studio October update adds commit-to-working-tree comparison, bulk merge conflict resolution, and several editor/UX refinements. It also refreshes Copilot chat, Hot Exit, keyboard tab controls, and Fonts and Colors.

  • Source: Visual Studio Blog

item.title: github: Turn notifications into code with GitHub Copilot in Teams
item.description:
GitHub introduced a new GitHub app for Microsoft Teams that combines notifications with Copilot, letting teams act on issues and create fixes without leaving the conversation.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Custom skills, agents, and MCP servers in usage metrics API
item.description:
GitHub Copilot usage metrics API now reports organization-created custom skills, agents, MCP servers, slash commands, and plugins by name instead of grouping them together.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Industry comparisons in the Copilot impact dashboard
item.description:
The Copilot impact dashboard now adds an “Industry comparison” section. Enterprises and non-enterprise-owned organizations can compare their Copilot agentic adoption and leverage against aggregated benchmarks.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Copilot model policy API for enterprise, orgs, and teams
item.description:
GitHub added REST API support to retrieve and update Copilot model policies for enterprises, enterprise teams, enterprise apps, and organizations. The change introduces new GET and PATCH endpoints for managing these policies.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Copilot code review: New organization billing options and controls
item.description:
GitHub added billing and license controls for Copilot code review at the organization level. Organization owners can now bill code review usage to the org for members with Copilot licenses and manage related controls.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Update your IDE to restore agent activity in Copilot usage metrics
item.description:
GitHub says some Copilot usage metrics showed declining agent activity and agent lines of code even as overall usage increased because of an IDE-related issue. A fix is rolling out, and users should update their IDE to restore correct agent activity reporting.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Usage metrics API adds pull request review stages
item.description:
GitHub’s enterprise and organization repository-level Copilot usage metrics reports now include pull request review stage timing. Each repos-1-day row gets a new pull_request_review_times array with time spent in each review stage.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Default Enablement of Copilot Features for Copilot Business and Enterprise
item.description:
GitHub is introducing a global default policy that enables generally available Copilot features and supported client capabilities in enterprise and organization Copilot settings. The change takes effect over a 28-day window.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Copilot code review: An improved review experience
item.description:
GitHub updated Copilot code review to make review changes easier to track over time, auto-resolve more of its own suggestions, and generate commit messages when suggestions are accepted.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Auto-resolution and analysis updates in Copilot code review
item.description:
Copilot code review now auto-resolves its own comments after you address them, and it can generate commit messages when you apply its code suggestions. The update also includes behind-the-scenes analysis changes.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Reopening Copilot Business and Enterprise signups
item.description:
GitHub is gradually reopening sign-ups for Copilot Business and Copilot Enterprise for customers paying by credit card or PayPal over the next few weeks. Availability is rolling out gradually to people who have been waiting to start.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Copilot code review: Resolution reasons and expanded capabilities
item.description:
Copilot code review now supports two additional pull request types: PRs authored by bots (including Copilot cloud agent) and very large pull requests. GitHub also added resolution reasons for code review outcomes.

  • Source: GitHub
